verdict.note: The one northern king Kings commends, for destroying the house of Ahab and Baal’s temple; the calves at Bethel and Dan stayed (10:29).

reign.note: Jehu killed Joram of Israel and Ahaziah of Judah on the same day (9:24, 27), so both kingdoms reach this point together. Laid end to end, Israel’s stated reigns from Jeroboam come to 98 years and Judah’s from Rehoboam to 95. Take one year from each northern reign counted in years (all but Zimri’s seven days), as a kingdom does that counts a king’s first part-year as his first year and his predecessor’s last, and Israel’s come to 90; count Judah’s the same way from Jehoram on, as Thiele does, and so do Judah’s.
